decision_rationale: The abstract describes domain-adapted 8-billion-parameter Llama and Qwen backbones and reports zero-shot performance on generative tasks, so this is a generative model paper. It also uses foundation-model-like backbones with broad pretraining and transfer/adaptation.
evidence_snippet: “domain-adapted 8-billion-parameter Llama and Qwen backbones ... benchmarked zero-shot performance on embedding-based and generative tasks”
